project_type: Monorepo: Python FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Worker edge + Vite/React frontend (9-pillar architecture)
build_system: pnpm workspaces, pip for backend, wrangler for edge
test_framework: pytest for backend, vitest for edge/frontend, playwright for e2e
build_command: N/A (test script is standalone shell script with curl/jq)
verification_instructions: Run bash scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh --dry-run to verify the script syntax and structure. Run shellcheck scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh for linting.
setup_instructions: Script requires: bash, curl, jq. No additional setup needed. Configurable via environment variables for different deployment targets.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Script is a curl-based cloud shell test meant to run against live or staging deployments. No local services needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing script patterns from scripts/live-deployment-test.sh and scripts/verify-before-merge.sh. Use consistent color output, pass/fail/warn tracking, and exit code handling.
key_patterns: Existing scripts use: set -euo pipefail, color codes (RED/GREEN/YELLOW/NC), pass()/fail()/warn() helpers, perform_request() for timed curl, summary section at the end with exit 0/1 based on critical failures. Tests are organized by architectural layer.
directory_structure: scripts/ - deployment/verification scripts; apps/backend/ - FastAPI (Python); apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker (TypeScript); apps/frontend/ - Vite/React (TypeScript)
